final_topology.title: Financial Data Ingestion Network
final_topology.description: A network designed for ingesting financial data feeds and processing them in dedicated market data pods, with outputs distributed to three campus sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network includes dedicated pods for data ingestion and processing, connected to three campus sites via trunk links for inter-site communication. Segmentation is enforced by function.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
controls.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes detailed data flow links between nodes, indicating documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different functions (e.g., Ingestion Pod, Market Data Pods, Security Zone) and firewalls to enforce segmentation.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: Firewalls (n11, n12) are present and linked to various servers and workloads, indicating managed firewalls.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: DNS servers (n13, n14) are present and linked to various nodes, indicating trusted DNS server configuration.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: An MFA/Identity Server (n15) is linked to the Remote Access Zone (z10) and the firewalls (n11, n12), indicating MFA for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: A DNS Filter (n24) is present and linked to the DNS servers (n13, n14), indicating DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: A Web Proxy (n16) and Application Firewall (n17) are present and linked to the firewalls (n11, n12), indicating network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones, firewalls, and links that enforce segmentation and least privilege.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes secure network protocols and management links (e.g., SSH, HTTPS) for network devices.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: An MFA/Identity Server (n15) is present and linked to various nodes, indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: A VPN Gateway (n25) is present and linked to the MFA/Identity Server (n15) and firewalls (n11, n12), indicating remote devices using a VPN and connecting to AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: An Admin Workstation (n22) is present in the Management Zone (z7) and linked to the MFA/Identity Server (n15), indicating dedicated administrative resources.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: A NIDS (n18) is present and linked to the firewalls (n11, n12), indicating a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: Firewalls (n11, n12) are present and linked to various zones, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: A NIPS (n19) is present and linked to the firewalls (n11, n12), indicating a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: A NAC (n21) is present and linked to the firewalls (n11, n12), indicating port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: A Web Proxy (n16) and Application Firewall (n17) are present and linked to the firewalls (n11, n12), indicating application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for production (e.g., Ingestion Pod, Market Data Pods) and non-production (e.g., Management Zone, Security Zone) systems.
